evidence: Verified against the complete settled-input.md and searched for scan/cursor, cadence/interval/tick, batch/backlog, fairness/starvation, latency/lag and equivalent progress mechanisms. The root Goal (line 41) promises a bounded-time warning; line 62 explicitly preserves bounded deadline detection while excluding bounded native submission. Lines 60 and 112 require historical overdue work on the normal bounded scan and bound scan work, but neither defines successive-scan progress or a warning-creation delay bound. The receipt subtree and ht-0lo.1.2 (lines 144, 681) require bounded indexed discovery and tests with unavailable recipients/blocked native wake, while ht-0lo.1.3 (line 369) names a bounded warning burst; none requires multi-batch backlog progress or establishes a bound under continuing due arrivals. Thus bounded work per invocation is specified without an explicit temporal/fair-progress contract or validation for the newly introduced upgrade burst. This is material to the stated bounded detection promise, not a request for bounded native delivery or unlimited scale. Should-fix: define the intended operating assumptions and progress bound and exercise multiple batches independently of native wake; the artifact alone does not establish that failure is likely enough to justify Blocking.
